subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI cannot queue input while Gateway reconnects

question: Should maintainers sponsor the narrow Control UI compose-while-reconnecting fix now, or hold this for a broader reconnect capability cleanup?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label, and the fix touches visible reconnect UX where maintainers may want to confirm the exact capability split before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow reconnect-composer fix
options.body: Allow composing and first-submit queueing while reconnecting, while keeping realtime-only actions and manual retry connection-bound.

options.title: Fold into broader capability-state cleanup
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of a larger Control UI state-machine cleanup that also addresses other capability-vs-flag issues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow reconnect-composer fix
recommendation.body: Allow composing and first-submit queueing while reconnecting, while keeping realtime-only actions and manual retry connection-bound.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related mounted reconnect shell and have the clearest recent ownership signal for this Control UI behavior.
